definitions.gloss: perfectionist tendency; obsessive temperament; fastidious nature
definitions.explanation: A personality trait of becoming deeply absorbed in something and pursuing it to a meticulous degree. Can describe the trait itself or a person who has it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凝|こ}り{性|しょう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: He has a perfectionist streak, so he does everything thoroughly.

examples.japanese: {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めたら→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えて→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Because of my perfectionist nature, once I start cooking, I end up buying all the tools and spices.

examples.japanese: {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧かけすぎてしまう。
examples.english: I have a tendency to get obsessive, so when I start a hobby, I end up spending too much money and time on it.

notes:
USAGE:
{凝|こ}り{性|しょう} comes from ⟦{凝|こ}る→凝る：08180_koru⟧ (to be devoted to, to be particular about) + ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (nature, temperament). It is usually used positively or neutrally, suggesting dedication rather than unhealthy obsession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person with perfectionist tendencies)
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a perfectionist streak)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {凝|こ}り{性|しょう}: gets deeply into things (personality trait)
- ⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: picky, particular about details
- ⟦{完璧主義|かんぺきしゅぎ}→完璧主義：12298_kanpekishugi⟧: perfectionism (stronger, can be negative)
